terms.comment: Our description: high shoes of rubber, with the modern adjective cummeus (Traupman 329, a rubber hose; M-O s.v. rubber). Neither Traupman nor Morgan–Owens has rubber boots; for boots in general see boots.

sources: Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. shoe: boot.
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 116, 329.
